queries: hydrogen fueling station vehicle pressure temperature mass flow raw time series
hydrogen refueling station vehicle fueling pressure temperature mass flow dataset
hydrogen station dispenser vehicle fueling time series pressure temperature
search_scope.eligibility_rule: A reusable physical experiment or in-use fill must expose station/controller and dispenser/nozzle plus vehicle/receptacle channels on a common time base, with initial conditions, units, tank capacity and protocol metadata.

candidates.name: NREL H2FillS
candidates.reason: The time-series fields are simulator outputs; the page does not provide independent measured station-to-vehicle logger traces.

candidates.name: NREL Next Generation Hydrogen Station Composite Data Products: Retail Stations
candidates.observed_role: aggregate station performance, reliability and safety statistics
candidates.reason: The published products are aggregate charts and summaries, not synchronized station/dispenser/vehicle raw time series.

candidates.name: MetHyTrucks Group B -- HySam system measurement data
candidates.reason: The workbooks contain sampling-system pressure/temperature/flow-like channels but no vehicle/receptacle tank channels, station controller state or full station-to-vehicle common-clock context. This source is already consumed under the frozen component diagnostic boundary.

candidates.name: California ARB light-duty HRS in-use study
candidates.observed_role: independent in-use station compliance study with plotted pressure, temperature and mass-flow traces
candidates.reason: The public report contains figures and test summaries, including station/CHSS variables, but no reusable machine-readable synchronized logger archive or raw-data licence was identified. It is therefore an operating-range and custodian-request lead, not an untouched holdout.

candidates.name: Cal State LA / 3Emotion back-to-back fueling study
candidates.observed_role: real station operating logs and back-to-back fueling analysis
candidates.reason: The paper describes multi-year operator logs and station/vehicle fueling metrics, but the public article record does not expose the synchronized event rows, channel dictionary, clock alignment and reuse terms required to score an independent holdout.

candidates.name: H2-Stations Europe API v2
candidates.observed_role: public station layout and availability/usage/storage-status registry
candidates.reason: The API exposes station metadata and aggregate status signals; numeric vehicle-side pressure/temperature, dispenser controller channels and synchronized transfer mass/flow are not published.

candidates.name: Hydrogen Fueling in FCEV: A Study
candidates.observed_role: open article describing fueling conditions and standards
candidates.reason: The Zenodo record provides a journal article PDF, not a measured station-to-vehicle logger dataset.

primary_goal_decision.paper_limitation: No openly reusable synchronized station-to-vehicle raw trace was identified in the recheck. The study therefore does not claim independent station-to-vehicle full-loop accuracy, vehicle-controller validation or field-safety validation.
primary_goal_decision.reentry_condition: A custodian must provide at least three rights-cleared, independently documented events with station/controller, dispenser/nozzle and vehicle/receptacle channels on a common time base, including units, initial conditions, tank capacity and protocol metadata; the analysis protocol must be frozen before outcome access.
